name: smwmusic-chrono-trigger-mystery-from-the-past
title: Chrono Trigger - Mystery from the Past
description: "Mystery from the Past" - or "Mystery of the Past" in certain less official translations - from Chrono Trigger. Composed by Nobuo Uematsu, this short little jingle could suit a mysterious event. I can also imagine this being a possible replacement for the "death" jingle, though the fact that this is a sampled port would make that pretty difficult to set up properly.
